open_gaps.description: The finite family list is a saturation checkpoint, not proof that every analytical method exists here.
open_gaps.resolution: Recurring literature/standard/vertical audits add governed records or explicit extension gaps.

open_gaps.description: Most candidate methods still need theorem-level applicability and counterexample records.
open_gaps.resolution: Attach machine-readable preconditions, guarantees and falsification fixtures per adjudicated method.

open_gaps.description: Provider seeds cite maintained docs but do not pin exact versions, features, builds and transitive dependencies.
open_gaps.resolution: Ingest signed provider manifests and generate exact offers.

open_gaps.description: Qualification records are deliberately unexecuted templates.
open_gaps.resolution: Execute profiles on exact targets and persist immutable evidence receipts.

open_gaps.description: Floating-point tolerance, order, mixed precision and parallel nondeterminism are not normalized across providers.
open_gaps.resolution: Define operation-specific numeric equivalence relations and qualify multiple implementations.

open_gaps.description: No universal fitted-model/index/plan artifact format covers all method families.
open_gaps.resolution: Keep artifacts provider-bound unless an explicit portable semantic/serialization contract is proved.

open_gaps.description: Rust-native coverage is strong for arrays/algebra/search but incomplete for broad statistics, causal, process, spatial and image methods.
open_gaps.resolution: Use pure Rust contributions where qualified and narrow removable adapters to external runtimes elsewhere.

open_gaps.description: ABI, allocator, panic, thread, license and supply-chain implications of native/provider libraries require separate qualification.
open_gaps.resolution: Bind feature/dependency/license manifests and run FFI safety profiles.

open_gaps.description: GPU/accelerator coverage, device transfer, cancellation and reproducibility are sparsely evidenced.
open_gaps.resolution: Add target-specific offers and receipts without changing semantic method records.

open_gaps.description: Compression ratios and speed are data-dependent; corrupt input and decompression expansion create hazards.
open_gaps.resolution: Qualify codecs on representative and adversarial corpora with hard output/memory/work limits.

open_gaps.description: OR is referenced, not copied; cross-references must be checked against every edition of the dedicated OR corpus.
open_gaps.resolution: Add an edition-aware cross-universe relation graph and validator.

open_gaps.description: Specialized econometric, epidemiological, psychometric, actuarial, chemometric, bioinformatic and engineering methods need vertical packs.
open_gaps.resolution: Extend through the closed metamodel; promote a method horizontally only after unrelated-domain evidence.

open_gaps.description: The compiler lacks an executable rule system that derives admissible methods from study/estimand/assumption contracts.
open_gaps.resolution: Encode admissibility as requirements, proofs and explicit ambiguity gaps—never a heuristic name lookup.

open_gaps.description: Method algorithms and kernels are not yet fully cross-referenced to the global typed-operation universe.
open_gaps.resolution: Adjudicate ownership and add exact operation/type/shape references.

open_gaps.description: No method/library boundary here has yet passed two unrelated vertical applications.
open_gaps.resolution: Bind and validate against unrelated cases before productization.
